changes.before: Introduced HB1063 specifies peak annual electricity demand of 100 megawatt hours or greater. Recovered Committee Substitute LC 60 0283S instead defines covered data centers by peak annual electricity demand of at least 100 megawatts and proposes utility-contract minimum billing, contract-term, credit/default and termination protections, prospective agreement applicability and PSC compliance determinations. This is a version/unit distinction, not a conversion. The recovered committee print alone does not establish identity with the House-passed substitute.
changes.after: Introduced HB1063 specifies peak annual electricity demand of 100 megawatt hours or greater. The House journal prints the adopted substitute on February 17, 2026, with a data-center definition requiring peak annual electricity demand of at least 100 megawatts, utility-contract minimum billing, contract-term, credit/default and termination protections, prospective agreement applicability and PSC compliance determinations. It records passage by substitute 159–5. The recovered Committee Substitute LC 60 0283S reproduces these operative clauses; the journal directly establishes the adopted text. This is a version/unit distinction, not a conversion, and no enacted duty is asserted.
